concept.title: How matches fade
concept.shortdesc: Everything you share with a match is temporary unless you both choose to keep each other.

conbody.p: When you and a match part, a 30-minute countdown starts. If you're together again before it ends, nothing is lost. If it runs out, the match ends.

Parting means your phones lose contact. can't run in the background, so closing the app or locking your phone also counts as parting. When you open the app again, the 30 minutes are counted from when you last saw each other.
